skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the nature and components of e-payment systems, including participants, tools, equipment, and media used in e-payments.
Students will be able to classify various types of e-payment methods based on time, transaction nature, acceptance methods, and payment instruments.
Students will know how to work with companies providing online payment services.
Students will be able to analyze the applications, advantages, disadvantages, common risks, and safety measures of different e-payment systems.
Students will develop skills to work independently and collaboratively in groups.
Students will learn how to self-study and conduct independent research.
